summary: Build climate-smart extension services skills in 5 days. Learn CSA advisory design, vulnerability tools, and monitoring templates to improve farmer adoption.
lede: Climate-smart extension services connect climate information with practical advice and farmer-facing support. For extension, advisory, and rural-development professionals, this course covers vulnerability assessment, seasonal planning, inclusive communication, climate-smart recommendations, and adoption monitoring with indicators and scorecards, helping them turn climate risks into field-ready advice and track how it is used.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in extension, advisory services, or rural development and need more practical climate-smart methods. It suits people who must turn climate information into field action, manage farmer-facing communication, and report results across programs and seasons.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for template-based exercises and be ready to work with simple spreadsheets, advisory templates, and sample field scenarios. Prior exposure to extension work, agricultural projects, or farmer support services will help you move faster through the applied exercises.
